def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors=sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg})
    mark=colors[0]
    accent=(mark+1)%10
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==mark]
        if len(cols)>=2:
            for c in range(cols[0],cols[-1]+1):
                if grid[r][c]==bg and (c-cols[0])%2==1:
                    out[r][c]=accent
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The most frequent color is the background; the other (marker) color
    # is expanded by inserting color 2 between markers two cells apart.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = min(v for v in range(10) if v != bg and counts[v] > 0)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == mark]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            if b - a == 2 and row[a + 1] == bg:
                out[r][a + 1] = 2
    return out
PY
